$comment: Configuration for .github/scripts/visual-gate. Every excludeStories entry needs the reason the story cannot reproduce itself — the list stays reviewable instead of growing quietly, and `gate.mjs flaky` is how entries are found (run it, do not guess). A key ending in * covers a whole story file.

excludeStories.lab-chartstreamgl--*: Streams live data on a setInterval; every frame is a different chart.
excludeStories.lab-chartstreamperf--*: Renders measured fps and frame times, which differ every run by construction.
excludeStories.lab-codeeditorperf--*: Renders performance.now() mount timings on screen.
excludeStories.lab-usechartrange--*: Advances its own domain on a setInterval while the shot is taken.
